thread:
devon (Support): Heads-up — BrightMap reporting sustained 5xxs on hosted inference in eu-west-1 since ~09:30 UTC. Both streaming and normal /v1/generate calls returning 502/504. Customers hit production, seeing timeouts and duplicate retries from our SDK. Can we triage?
ashok (Eng-SRE): On it. Any sample request IDs or curl we can repro with?
devon (Support): Pasting a minimal repro and one of the failing response headers we captured. Token removed.
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response headers from customer: `HTTP/2 502`, `x-edge-id: euw1-pr-12`, `x-request-id: rq-89a2`. Body: truncated chunk reset.
kelly (Support): BrightMap reported SDK auto-retries were on (default). They saw repeated billing increments because some attempts succeeded after retries; unhappy customer.
maria (Runtime): I'm seeing a matching spike in edge-proxy logs — connection pool saturation and long queue times to the inference workers. There are signs of KV cache lock contention for large-ctx requests (~12k tokens) causing worker threads to stall.
ashok (Eng-SRE): Pls collect: X-Request-Id header, edge container id (x-edge-id), client IP, and a sample of request sizes. I'm kicking off a quick probe to check worker queue lengths.
devon (Support): Collected and uploaded to /shared/support/euw1-5xx-batch. Sample x-edge-id: euw1-pr-12, x-request-id rq-89a2, client ip 18.44.22.91.
maria (Runtime): Confirmed — worker queue backlog jumped at 09:28 UTC. KV cache serialization appears to be taking long for requests with >8k tokens; this blocks async write path and causes the front proxy to hit conn timeouts.
ashok (Eng-SRE): Short mitigation: set a temporary routing rule to steer new traffic from the affected tenant to eu-west-2 fallback and throttle heavy parallelism from that tenant (rate-limit per api-key). Also bump worker concurrency for euw1 pool to drain backlog.
kelly (Support): Communicated to BrightMap: temporary regional routing and we suggest SDK retry config change to exponential backoff + jitter and reduce max attempts to 3. They asked for ETA.
maria (Runtime): ETA for worker concurrency bump and routing change: 15-25 mins. Patching autoscaler to allow +20% headroom now.
sre-bot: deploy 1810011200 by maria/runtime: worker-concurrency bump applied to euw1 pool (rolling).
maria (Runtime): After bump and soft-throttle, error rate down 85% and p95 latency improved. Still seeing a few 502s tied to single huge prompts; recommending a soft input-size guardrail on hosted API and a guidance doc for customers about chunking large contexts.
kelly (Support): Updated BrightMap — they confirmed error rate dropped and billing spike paused. They're ok with the routing fallback for now.
devon (Support): Follow-ups: (1) Add customer-facing KB on large-ctx guidance, (2) ticket to runtime team to optimize KV cache path, (3) product docs to include recommended SDK retry settings to avoid duplicate billing.
maria (Runtime): Will open an internal ticket with profiling traces and proposed KV cache async rewrite.
ashok (Eng-SRE): I'll keep this thread open until postmortem. Posting link to short mitigation runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/eu-conn-surge.
devon (Support): Thanks all — leaving for status update to acct team in 30m. :thumbsup:
